dct_description_sm:
Squamish off-site utility service connections line features; water, sanitary,storm etc. where available. Connection from main to property lines.
Please Note:  The service connection data is complied through subdivision servicing drawings and may not reflect the actual location of installed services.  Submit a BC One Call request before you dig!
